verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own SRE Agent is documented to diagnose and troubleshoot incidents. It pulls telemetry such as Sentry logs and analyzes code in GitHub, and pricing describes automated investigation by agents, so the core AI-investigator capability exists. The evidence does not show it correlating recent changes or similar past incidents, or confirm it starts investigating unprompted. Missing for 10: documented correlation of change events with probable cause, similar-past-incident matching by the agent, explicit proactive auto-start of investigation on incident trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks
